scope: Retrospective pilot on current A–E, with earlier B and C kept separate. Three full 10 s runs per visit, empty / occupied / empty. Use the previous aligned READY +3 to +21 ms window and decoder. No human coordinates, calibration from human labels, reference transfer across visits, or angle-dependent sign choice at prediction time.
primary: Background-subspace-projected MUSIC. Per tone/state take b as the leading R1 eigenvector; B=I-bb^H. Obtain the leading unit vector u of B Rt B. Use N=B-u u^H as the local noise projector, jointly minimize sum(a^H N a)/sum(a^H B a) over all included states and tones. Remove tones if b is not identifiable, b explains <70% of reference energy, or residual principal power fails to exceed all four reference-quarter residual principal powers. No spectrum peak averaging or multiplication. Reject a direction if total projected steering energy is <10% of original energy. Each claimed state must have valid projectors on at least half the tones in the tested band.
signed_rank: Secondary: eigenvectors of Hermitian Rt-R1 of either sign. Estimate dimension from |lambda| > max over R1 quarters of ||R1q-R1||_2. Only ranks 1 or 2 are usable; rank 0 or 3 abstains for that tone. Noise complement includes the other directions, normalized by 3/(3-rank). Do not claim that negative changes are a second target. The positive rank-one variant with a pooled noise denominator is the comparator.
fairness: Predeclared single-triplet reference G2; separately show G3 and all six triads (including sparse C1/C2). All 2/3/4-combinations of disjoint G groups represent 6/9/12 unique antennas. All six states also cover 12 antennas but add sparse within-state baselines. Compare native all packets and equal total packet budgets for every configuration, same acquisition time. For each visit use M=12*floor(min eligible packets in any quarter/run/state /12) packets per quarter. Distribute M evenly over the states tested; deterministically sample evenly across time, no replacement, no amplitude selection. Every arm takes 4M packets per run and per reference in matched mode.
geometry: Primary is plane wave. For joint four-G / all-six architectures only, test finite-range steering at RX-centred radii 0.75,1.5,3,6 m plus plane limit, over the whole +/-90 degree 1-degree grid. Profile the residual over radius as a sensitivity test. No physical ToF or position estimate. Separate ideal geometry from observed performance; compute within-triplet lags, centered second moments and the C2 +48/-18 steering ambiguity.
checks: R1-only numerical floors, without R3 for training. Same prior stability gates across single and multi-state arms: foreground peak away from +/-87, both half-band peaks within 9 deg, >=3/4 quarter global peaks within 9 deg, reversed background R2 within 9 deg, positive beam-change intensity ratio R2/R3 >1, and no nearby equally stable empty global peak. Keep unavailable spectra and all failures. Compare all usable errors and separately give output coverage; no post hoc algorithm switching per point.
evidence: Freeze protocol and candidates before attaching survey truth. Use per-configuration physical-centre truth; report hardware comparison using preassigned G2. In a second contrast single G2 and all-six are also compared against the same RX-centre direction as a sensitivity. Primary matched-packet gain claim requires improved observed error and comparable validated-output coverage, and independent visits are required for generalization. Original data and thesis untouched.
